# Pikar AI

> A governed agentic AI operating layer. You state a goal in plain language; Pikar plans it,
> shows you the plan, and — once you approve — executes it autonomously under cost and privacy
> guardrails, reporting each stage and writing every action to an append-only audit log.

Pikar AI is an AI chief of staff for solopreneurs and small teams. Its distinguishing property is
governance: a human approves the plan before any work runs, guardrails (cost ceilings, PII
redaction, quality checks) execute before any external model call, and every action is recorded in
a log that cannot be edited or deleted.

With the user's explicit one-time consent, Pikar's agents connect to the user's tools — beginning
with Gmail, where they can read, draft, send, and organise mail. Pikar never requests permission to
permanently delete email.

## Pages

- [Home](https://pikar-ai.com/): What Pikar AI is, how it works, and the guarantees it makes.
- [Privacy Policy](https://pikar-ai.com/privacy): How data is collected, used, stored and shared,
  including Google user data and GDPR rights.
- [Terms of Service](https://pikar-ai.com/terms): Terms governing use, including responsibility for
  messages sent through a connected account.
